cases.name: Unnamed Woman
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: A relative of the woman told investigators she had gone to his trailer to offer him food. When she didn’t return, the relative went to check on her, saw her facedown and unresponsive in the trailer, then ran to get help. Police found her in his trailer, her hands bound behind her back, ankles tied together and a cord looped around her neck, with an apparent stab wound to her back.
